definition: Auditing outpatient coding checks whether codes for non-inpatient encounters match the documentation and applicable coding rules.
example: An auditor compares charges for an outpatient office visit with the services documented in the record.

definition: Auditing systematically examines evidence to evaluate whether statements, practices, or controls meet specified criteria.
example: An auditor samples purchase records to assess whether payments received the required approvals.

definition: Aural rehabilitation helps people with hearing loss improve communication through training, strategies, and appropriate assistive supports.
example: A clinician and client practice speech recognition and strategies for conversations in noisy spaces.

definition: Aurelia is a JavaScript framework for building client-side applications with components, templates, and data binding.
example: A developer binds a view to an editable customer profile model.

definition: Author-it is a component content management and authoring platform for reusing structured content across publications.
example: A documentation team updates a shared topic once and republishes several manuals.

definition: Autism therapy encompasses individualized clinical or developmental supports intended to help autistic people pursue communication, daily living, or other chosen goals.
example: A therapist and client choose a communication goal and evaluate whether a new support is useful.
sense_note: This is an umbrella term, not one treatment, and does not imply a goal of eliminating autism.

definition: Auto glass installation and repair assess, repair, or replace vehicle windows while maintaining visibility and structural fit.
example: A technician replaces a cracked windshield and checks that the installation meets vehicle specifications.

definition: Autodesk 123D was a family of consumer tools for creating and preparing digital 3D designs.
example: A hobbyist creates a simple model and exports it for fabrication.

definition: Automotive detailing thoroughly cleans, restores, and protects a vehicle’s interior and exterior surfaces.
example: A detailer cleans fabric seats and protects painted surfaces after removing road residue.

definition: An autoregressive integrated moving-average model forecasts a univariate time series through differencing and terms based on prior values and forecast errors.
example: An analyst models weekly demand and checks whether its residuals retain time dependence.

definition: Autoshade was an Autodesk rendering application for producing shaded images from three-dimensional AutoCAD geometry.
example: A designer renders an older CAD model to review how its surfaces appear.
sense_note: The suggested sense is the historical Autodesk renderer.

definition: AvantGo was a mobile service for synchronizing web content to handheld devices for later reading.
example: A traveler downloads news to a handheld and reads it offline.

definition: AVEVA PI System captures, stores, and contextualizes time-series data from industrial operations.
example: A plant engineer compares motor temperature readings over several shifts.

definition: An aviation medical examination assesses whether an individual meets health requirements for a defined aviation role or certification.
example: A designated examiner evaluates an applicant’s fitness for the requested aviation medical certificate.

definition: Avid Elastic Reality was a visual-effects application for morphing and warping images or video.
example: A compositor uses shape-based morphing to transition between two images.

definition: Avid Media Composer is a nonlinear video editing application for organizing media and assembling edited productions.
example: An editor synchronizes recorded audio to camera footage and revises a sequence.

definition: AWS big data refers to the use of Amazon Web Services to ingest, store, process, and analyze large or complex datasets.
example: A team combines object storage and distributed processing to summarize telemetry.
sense_note: This is a service area rather than a single AWS product.

definition: AWS Cloud9 is a cloud-based integrated development environment for editing, running, and debugging code in a browser.
example: A developer maintains an existing project from its hosted workspace.

definition: AWS CloudFormation provisions and manages groups of AWS resources from declarative infrastructure templates.
example: A team recreates a test environment using the same reviewed template as its staging environment.

definition: AWS CloudHSM provides dedicated cloud hardware security modules for managing cryptographic keys and performing cryptographic operations.
example: An application signs a document using a key controlled within a hardware security module.

definition: AWS CloudTrail records supported activity in an AWS account so teams can audit actions and changes.
example: An investigator checks which identity changed a storage resource’s configuration.

definition: AWS CodeBuild is a managed service that runs specified build and test steps and produces build artifacts.
example: A team runs regression tests and packages the application on each approved change.

definition: AWS CodeCommit is a managed service that hosts private Git repositories in AWS.
example: A team reviews changes in a private repository integrated with its AWS identity controls.

definition: The AWS Command Line Interface invokes AWS service operations through terminal commands or scripts.
example: An administrator lists the resources that belong to a development account.

definition: AWS Elastic Beanstalk deploys applications while managing much of the supporting AWS infrastructure.
example: A team uploads a web application and lets the platform manage its deployment environment.

definition: AWS IoT is a family of services for connecting devices, processing their messages, and managing fleets.
example: A monitoring team collects authorized temperature readings from equipment at multiple sites.

definition: AWS Lambda is a managed service that executes code on demand in response to invocations and events.
example: A file upload triggers a function that validates the file’s metadata.

definition: AWS networking involves configuring connectivity, routing, isolation, and traffic management for AWS resources.
example: An engineer puts a service in a private subnet and allows access through an approved endpoint.

definition: AWS OpsWorks was a family of AWS configuration-management offerings for automating infrastructure and application setup.
example: An operations team applies a managed configuration policy to a group of servers.

definition: AWS Outposts extends selected AWS infrastructure and services into a customer’s on-premises or colocated facility.
example: A company processes data locally while using AWS tools to operate the on-site infrastructure.

definition: An AWS Software Development Kit exposes programming interfaces for calling AWS services from application code.
example: A developer uploads a file to object storage through the SDK for the application’s language.

definition: AWS serverless refers to building systems with managed services that avoid direct administration of the underlying servers.
example: An order event triggers managed compute and stores a record in a managed database.

definition: Amazon Web Services is a cloud platform providing on-demand computing, storage, networking, and other managed services.
example: A company hosts a web application using cloud compute and a managed database.

definition: Axios is a promise-based JavaScript HTTP client for browsers and Node.js.
example: A front end fetches account data and displays an error if the request fails.

definition: Azure Application Insights monitors application performance by collecting telemetry such as requests, dependencies, exceptions, and traces.
example: An engineer traces a slow API request through its downstream service calls.

definition: Azure Cognitive Services is the historical name for a family of cloud APIs that add capabilities such as language, speech, and vision processing to applications.
example: A developer adds automatic transcription using a managed speech service.

definition: Azure Data Factory is a managed data integration service for orchestrating data movement and transformations.
example: A team schedules nightly ingestion from an operational database into an analytical store.

definition: Azure DevOps provides tools for software project tracking, source control, build pipelines, and release workflows.
example: A team links a work item to the pull request and build that implement it.

definition: Azure IoT comprises cloud and device services for securely connecting and monitoring fleets of connected devices.
example: An operator tracks telemetry from remotely deployed meters.

definition: Azure Monitor collects and analyzes operational telemetry across cloud and connected resources.
example: An operations team uses a dashboard and alerts to detect an increase in service failures.
